subject.title: feat(ui): syntax-highlight read-only automation scripts in Control UI

question: Should this protected Control UI change be accepted after a maintainer verifies the rendered highlighted and resizable code block against a real automation detail view?
rationale: The patch is small and appears to preserve the editing boundary, but the `maintainer` label requires explicit human handling and the supplied review context lacks the actual visual artifact needed to independently assess the user-visible result.

options.title: Verify proof and merge
options.body: Inspect a redacted before/after screenshot or recording of a real locked script or command payload, then land the focused UI change if it matches the claimed behavior.

options.title: Request narrower proof
options.body: Ask the contributor to attach a redacted artifact that visibly shows highlighting, keyboard focus or scrolling, and vertical resizing before deciding.

recommendation.title: Verify proof and merge
recommendation.body: Inspect a redacted before/after screenshot or recording of a real locked script or command payload, then land the focused UI change if it matches the claimed behavior.
